76716.meaning1: set out towards the certainty (of); surely headed (towards)
76716.commentary: (THa) dhuvappayāto maraṇāyā'ti, maraṇassa atthāya ek'antagamano, nibbattito paṭṭhāya maraṇaṃ pati pavatto. tato eva maccurājassa maraṇassa santike ṭhito.

examples.text: dhuvappayāto maraṇāya, maccurājassa santike, idh'eva chaḍḍayitvāna, yenakāmaṅ'gamo naro.

76717.commentary: (THa) catuganthenā'ti, abhijjhākāyaganth'ādinā catubbidhena ganthena ganthito, ganthaniyabhāvena vinaddhito.

examples.text: avijjāya nivuto kāyo, catuganthena ganthito, oghasaṃsīdano kāyo, anusayajāla'm'otthato.

76718.meaning1: able to be tied; should be knotted together

examples.text: avijjāya nivuto kāyo, catuganthena ganthito, oghasaṃsīdano kāyo, anusayajāla'm'otthato.

76720.meaning1: sinking in the floods; drowning in the deluges

examples.text: avijjāya nivuto kāyo, catuganthena ganthito, oghasaṃsīdano kāyo, anusayajāla'm'otthato.

76721.commentary: (ADha) ārammaṇaṃ katvā atikkamanīyato oghehi atikkamitabbā'ti oghaniyā. oghānaṃ ārammaṇadhammā eva veditabbā.

76722.meaning1: covered with the web of dormant dispositions; caught in the net of underlying tendencies
76722.commentary: (THa) appahīnabhāvena santāne anu anu sentī'ti anusayā, kāmarāg'ādayo anusayā. tesaṃ jālena otthato abhibhūto'ti anusayājāla'm'otthato. makāro padasandhikaro, gāthāsukh'atthaṃ dīghaṃ katvā vuttaṃ.

examples.text: avijjāya nivuto kāyo, catuganthena ganthito, oghasaṃsīdano kāyo, anusayajāla'm'otthato.

76723.meaning1: accompanied by the source of craving

examples.text: pañcanīvaraṇe yutto, vitakkena samappito, taṇhāmūlen'ānugato, mohacchādanachādito.

76724.meaning1: veiled by delusion; shrouded in illusion
76724.meaningLit: covered by the covering of delusion

examples.text: pañcanīvaraṇe yutto, vitakkena samappito, taṇhāmūlen'ānugato, mohacchādanachādito.
ev'āyaṃ vattate kāyo, kammayantena yantito, sampatti ca vipaty'antā, nānābhāvo vipajjati.

76726.meaning1: ending in disaster; culminating in calamity
76726.commentary: (THa) sampatti ca vipaty'antā'ti yā ettha sampatti, sā vipattipariyosānā.

examples.text: ev'āyaṃ vattate kāyo, kammayantena yantito, sampatti ca vipaty'antā, nānābhāvo vipajjati.

76727.commentary: (THa) ye'maṃ kāyaṃ vivajjenti, gūthalittaṃ'va pannagan'ti yathā nāma puriso sukhakāmo jīvitu'kāmo gūthagataṃ āsīvisaṃ disvā jigucchaniyatāya vā sappaṭibhayatāya vā vivajjeti na allīyati, evam'evaṃ ye paṇḍitā kulaputtā asucibhāvena jegucchaṃ anicc'ādibhāvena sappaṭibhayaṃ imaṃ kāyaṃ vivajjenti chandarāgappahānena pajahanti.

examples.text: ye'maṃ kāyaṃ vivajjenti, gūthalittaṃ'va pannagaṃ, bhavamūlaṃ vamitvāna, parinibbissanti'n'āsavā'ti.

76729.commentary: (DNa) cattāro sammappadhānā'ti paggah'aṭṭhena ekalakkhaṇā, kiccavasena nānākiccā. idha bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāyā'ti-ādinā nayena samathavipassanāmaggavasena lokiyalok'uttara-missakā'va cattāro sammappadhānā desitā. (MNa) sammappadhānā'ti maggapadhānena sammappadhānā. (SNa) yoniso sammappadhānā'ti upāyavīriyena kāraṇavīriyena. (THa) sammappadhānasampanno'ti sampanna-catubbidha-sammappadhāno, tehi kattabbakiccaṃ sampādetvā ṭhito'ti attho.

examples.text: sammappadhānasampanno, satipaṭṭhānagocaro, vimuttikusumasañchanno, parinibbissaty'anāsavo'ti.

evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ayaṃ dhammavinayo bahuratano anekaratano, tatr'imāni ratanāni, seyyath'idaṃ, cattāro satipaṭṭhānā, cattāro sammappadhānā, cattāro iddhipādā, pañc'indriyāni, pañca balāni, satta bojjh'aṅgā, ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo

76730.meaning1: cleaning all the defilements; purifying all impurities

examples.text: yadā sivaṃ dvecaturaṅgagāminaṃ, magg'uttamaṃ sabbakilesasodhanaṃ, paññāya passitva sato'va jhāyati, tato ratiṃ paramataraṃ na vindati.

76731.meaning1: eradicating stains, coldness and sorrow; banishing impurity, hard-heartedness and grief
76731.commentary: (THa) malakhilasokanāsano'ti rāg'ādīnaṃ malānaṃ pañcannañ'ca cetokhilānaṃ ñātiviyog'ādihetukassa sokassa ca pahāyako.

examples.text: yadā sukhī malakhilasokanāsano, niraggaḷo nibbanatho visallo, sabb'āsave byantikato'va jhāyati, tato ratiṃ paramataraṃ na vindatī'ti.

76732.meaning1: inhabited by wild beasts; frequented by fierce animals
76732.commentary: (THa) vāḷamiganisevitan'ti, sīhabyagghadīpivāḷamigehi caritaṃ. (THa) vāḷamiganisevite'ti, sīhabyagghādīhi vāḷamigehi upasevite vane.

examples.text: vivittaṃ appanigghosaṃ, vāḷamiganisevitaṃ, seve sen'āsanaṃ bhikkhu, paṭisallānakāraṇā.

76733.meaning1: purpose of privacy; reason of seclusion
76733.commentary: (THa) paṭisallānakāraṇā'ti, paṭisallānanimittaṃ, nān'ārammaṇato nivattetvā kammaṭṭhāne'y'eva cittassa paṭi paṭi samma'd'eva allīyan'atthaṃ.

examples.text: vivittaṃ appanigghosaṃ, vāḷamiganisevitaṃ, seve sen'āsanaṃ bhikkhu, paṭisallānakāraṇā.
saṅkārapuñjā āhatvā, susānā rathiyāhi ca, tato saṅghāṭikaṃ katvā, lūkhaṃ dhāreyya cīvaraṃ.

76736.commentary: (THa) n'ātivelaṃ sambhāseyyā'ti ativelaṃ atikkantapamāṇaṃ na bhāseyya, mattabhāṇī assā'ti attho.

examples.text: yathā jaḷo va mūgo va, attānaṃ dassaye tathā, n'ātivelaṃ sambhāseyya, saṅghamajjhamhi paṇḍito.

76737.meaning1: taken hold of tightly; properly grasped; held firmly
76737.commentary: (THa) suggahītanimittassā'ti evaṃ me manasi karoto cittaṃ samāhitaṃ ahosī'ti tadākāraṃ sallakkhento suṭṭhu gahitasamādhinimitto assa. suggahītanimitto so'ti'pi pāṭho, so yogī'ti attho. (THa) suggahītañ'ca gaṇhātī'ti ten'eva kovidabhāvena atthato byañjanato ca dhammaṃ sugahitam'eva katvā gaṇhāti. (JAa) suggahītasmiṃ kaṭṭhasmin'ti mukhena suṭṭhu ḍaṃsitvā gahite daṇḍake.

examples.text: suggahītanimitt'assa, cittass'uppādakovido, samaṃ anuyuñjeyya, kālena ca vipassanaṃ.
pubb'āparaññū atthaññū, niruttipadakovido, suggahītañ'ca gaṇhāti, atthañ'c'opaparikkhati.

76738.meaning1: with meditation subject properly grasped; with the theme of contemplation taken hold of tightly
76738.commentary: (THa) suggahītanimittassā'ti evaṃ me manasi karoto cittaṃ samāhitaṃ ahosī'ti tadākāraṃ sallakkhento suṭṭhu gahitasamādhinimitto assa. suggahītanimitto so'ti'pi pāṭho, so yogī'ti attho.

examples.text: suggahītanimitt'assa, cittass'uppādakovido, samaṃ anuyuñjeyya, kālena ca vipassanaṃ.

76739.meaning1: skilled in (the causes for the arising of) mental states; expert in the inclinations of the mind
76739.commentary: (THa) cittass'uppādakovido'ti evaṃ bhāvayato cittaṃ līnaṃ hoti, evaṃ uddhatan'ti līnassa uddhatassa ca cittassa uppattikāraṇe kusalo assa. līne hi citte dhammavicaya-vīriya-pītisambojjh'aṅgā bhāvetabbā, uddhate passaddhi-samādhi-upekkhā-sambojjh'aṅgā. satisambojjh'aṅgo pana sabbattha icchitabbo.

examples.text: suggahītanimitt'assa, cittass'uppādakovido, samaṃ anuyuñjeyya, kālena ca vipassanaṃ.

76740.meaning1: possessing energy and perseverance; endowed with effort and persistence; (or) with persistent effort
76740.commentary: (THa) satatabhāvo sātaccaṃ, vīriyassa sātaccaṃ, tena sampanno samannāgato, satatapavattavīriyo, niccapaggahitavīriyo'ti attho.

examples.text: vīriyasātaccasampanno, yuttayogo sadā siyā, na ca appatvā dukkh'antaṃ, vissāsaṃ eyya paṇḍito.

76742.meaning1: end of suffering; cessation of stress
76742.commentary: (THa) dukkh'antan'ti vaṭṭadukkhassa antaṃ pariyosānaṃ nirodhaṃ nibbānaṃ appatvā vissāsaṃ na eyya na gaccheyya.

examples.text: vīriyasātaccasampanno, yuttayogo sadā siyā, na ca appatvā dukkh'antaṃ, vissāsaṃ eyya paṇḍito.
evaṃ viharamānassa, suddhikāmassa bhikkhuno, khīyanti āsavā sabbe, nibbutiñ'c'ādhigacchatī'ti.
buddhesu sagāravatā, dhamme apaciti yathābhūtaṃ, saṅghe ca cittikāro, etaṃ samaṇassa patirūpaṃ.

76745.meaning1: basis for success; road to power; basis for spiritual power
76745.commentary: (NIDD1a) catunnaṃ iddhipādānan'ti ettha chandavīriyacittavīmaṃsāsu ek'eko ijjhatī'ti iddhi, samijjhati nipphajjatī'ti attho. ijjhanti vā etāya sattā iddhā vuddhā ukkaṃsagatā hontī'ti iddhi. paṭhamena atthena iddhi'y'eva pādo'ti iddhipādo, iddhikoṭṭhāso'ti attho. dutiyena atthena iddhiyā pādo'ti iddhipādo, pādo'ti patiṭṭhā adhigam'upāyo'ti attho.

examples.text: bhāveyya ca bojjh'aṅge, iddhipādāni indriyāni balāni, aṭṭh'aṅgamaggamariyaṃ, etaṃ samaṇassa patirūpaṃ.

76746.meaning1: (comm) name of a mountain; (or) name of a bird
76746.commentary: (THa) ujjuhāno'va pāvuse'ti ujjuhāno kira nāma eko pabbato, so pana gahanasañchanno bahusoṇḍikandaro, tahaṃ tahaṃ sandamānasalilo, vassakāle asappāyo, tasmā ujjuhāno vā pabbato eta'r'ahi pāvusakāle tava kim'atthiyo'ti attho. keci pan'ettha ujjuhāno nāma eko sakuṇo sītaṃ na sahati, vassakāle vanagumbe nilīno acchatī'ti vadanti. tesaṃ matena ujjuhānassa viya sakuṇassa pāvusakāle ko tava attho vane'ti?

examples.text: kiṃ tav'attho vane tāta, ujjuhāno'va pāvuse, verambhā ramaṇīyā te, paviveko hi jhāyinaṃ.

76748.meaning1: connected with seclusion; concerned with solitude; related to detachment

examples.text: yathā abbhāni verambho, vāto nudati pāvuse, saññā me abhikiranti, vivekapaṭisaññutā.

76749.commentary: (THa) ñātakā hotu, vaḍḍhitakāle amhākaṃ ayyassa sāriputtattherassa santike taṃ pabbājessāmā'ti vatvā saṅkunā chinnakkhikoṭitāya saṃkicco'ti vadantā aparabhāge saṃkicco'ti vohariṃsu. so sattavassikakāle attano gabbhagatasseva mātu maraṇaṃ, gabbhe ca attano pavattiṃ sutvā saṃvegajāto pabbajissāmī'ti āha. ñātakā sādhu, tātā'ti dhammasenāpatissa santikaṃ netvā, bhante, imaṃ pabbājethā'ti adaṃsu. thero taṃ tacapañcakakammaṭṭhānaṃ datvā pabbājesi.
76749.notes: Theragāthā verses 597-607 (TH11.1, TH240) are attributed to him.

examples.text: saṃkiccathero eko'va, katakicco anāsavo, ekādasanipātamhi, gāthā ekādas'eva cā'ti.

76750.commentary: (THa) vittilābhan'ti tuṭṭhilābhaṃ. vittalābhan'ti ca paṭhan'ti, dhanalābhan'ti attho. sīlavā hi appamattatāya mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ adhigacchati.

examples.text: sīlaṃ rakkheyya medhāvī, patthayāno tayo sukhe, pasaṃsaṃ vittilābhañ'ca, pecca sagge pamodanaṃ.

76751.commentary: (THa) kalyāṇānañ'ca mātukan'ti samathavipassan'ādīnaṃ kalyāṇadhammānaṃ mātubhūtaṃ, janakan'ti, attho.

examples.text: ādi sīlaṃ patiṭṭhā ca, kalyāṇānañ'ca mātukaṃ, pamukhaṃ sabbadhammānaṃ, tasmā sīlaṃ visodhaye.

76752.synonym: attamana, avighātavant, āraddhacitta, tuṭṭhi, patīta, patītarūpa, pamodavant, mudita, sammudita, sukhita, susajjita, somanassajāta

examples.text: idh'eva kittiṃ labhati, pecca sagge ca summano, sabbattha sumano dhīro, sīlesu susamāhito.

76753.meaning1: with little food; not having much to eat
76753.commentary: (THa) ahaṃ pana sabbakālaṃ kasiravuttitāya hīno uddhanaṃ upaṭṭhapitaukkhaliko dassanayuttaṃ thevakam'pi apassiṃ yevā'ti dassento appabhojano'ti āha.

examples.text: nīce kulamhi jāto'haṃ, daliddo appabhojano, hīnakammaṃ mamaṃ āsi, ahosiṃ pupphachaḍḍako.

76754.meaning1: having food; with food to eat; regarding food
76754.commentary: (Aa) asiddhabhojano'ti na te kiñci amhākaṃ kandamūlaṃ vā paṇṇaṃ vā seditaṃ.

examples.text: nīce kulamhi jāto'haṃ, daliddo appabhojano, hīnakammaṃ mamaṃ āsi, ahosiṃ pupphachaḍḍako.
abhinnakaṭṭho'si anābhat'odako, ahāpit'aggī'si asiddhabhojano, na me tuvaṃ ālapasī mam'ajja, naṭṭhaṃ nu kiṃ cetasikañ'ca dukkhaṃ.

76755.commentary: (THa) nīcakulikā daliddā'pi keci anīcakamm'ājīvā honti, mayhaṃ pana na tathā'ti dassento āha hīnakammaṃ mamaṃ āsī'ti.

examples.text: nīce kulamhi jāto'haṃ, daliddo appabhojano, hīnakammaṃ mamaṃ āsi, ahosiṃ pupphachaḍḍako.

76756.meaning1: having compassion for the whole world; concerned for all the world

examples.text: tato kāruṇiko satthā, sabbalok'ānukampako, ehi bhikkhū'ti maṃ āha, sā me ās'ūpasampadā.
rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ, pubbajātim'anussariṃ, rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ, dibbacakkhuṃ visodhayiṃ, rattiyā pacchime yāme, tamokhandhaṃ padālayiṃ.

76758.meaning1: surrounded by the heavenly host; accompanied by the assembly of gods

examples.text: tato disvāna maṃ satthā, devasaṅghapurakkhataṃ, sitaṃ pātukaritvāna, imam'atthaṃ abhāsatha.

76759.commentary: (THa) sabbesaṃ sattānaṃ mitto, sabbe vā te mayhaṃ mittā'ti sabbamitto. mettañ'hi bhāvento sattānaṃ piyo hoti. sabbasakho'ti, etthā'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: sabbamitto sabbasakho, sabbabhūt'ānukampako, mettacittañ'ca bhāvemi, abyāpajjarato sadā.
yathā'pi bhaddo ājañño, dhure yutto dhurassaho, mathito atibhārena, saṃyugaṃ n'ātivattati.

76761.meaning1: power of time; authority of time
76761.commentary: (THa) kālavasaṃ pattā'ti lābh'ādikālassa ca vasaṃ upagatā, lābh'ādinā somanassitā alābh'ādinā ca domanassitā'ti attho.

examples.text: kāle kālavasaṃ pattā, bhav'ābhavavasaṃ gatā, narā dukkhaṃ nigacchanti, te'dha socanti māṇavā.

76762.meaning1: power of existence and nonexistence; sway of being and non-being
76762.commentary: (THa) bhav'ābhavavasaṃ gatā'ti bhavassa abhavassa ca vasaṃ upagatā vuddhihāniyo anuvattantā te.

examples.text: kāle kālavasaṃ pattā, bhav'ābhavavasaṃ gatā, narā dukkhaṃ nigacchanti, te'dha socanti māṇavā.

76764.meaning1: raised or lowered; elevated or depressed; elated or downcast

examples.text: ye ca dukkhe sukhasmiñ'ca, majjhe sibbinim'accagū, ṭhitā te indakhīlo'va, na te unnataonatā.

76765.grammar: masc, from na na labhati, neg x2
76765.commentary: (THa) lābhe'ti cīvar'ādīnaṃ paccayānaṃ paṭilābhe. alābhe'ti tesaṃ'y'eva appaṭilābhe apagame.

examples.text: na h'eva lābhe n'ālābhe, na yase na ca kittiyā, na nindāyaṃ pasaṃsāya, na te dukkhe sukhamhi.

76766.synonym: adhīra, apaṇḍita, avicakkhaṇa, duppañña, duppaññajātika, dummedha, dummedhī
76766.commentary: (THa) yaso ca appabuddhīnaṃ, viññūnaṃ ayaso ca yo'ti yo appabuddhīnaṃ duppaññānaṃ vasena puggalassa yaso labbhati

examples.text: yaso ca appabuddhīnaṃ, viññūnaṃ ayaso ca yo, ayaso'va seyyo viññūnaṃ, na yaso appabuddhinaṃ.

76767.meaning1: praise by fools; approval of idiots
76767.commentary: (THa) yañ'ce bālappasaṃsanā'ti bālehi aviddasūhi yā nāma pasaṃsanā.

examples.text: dummedhehi pasaṃsā ca, viññūhi garahā ca yā, garahā'va seyyo viññūhi, yaṃ ce bālappasaṃsanā.
dummedhehi pasaṃsā ca, viññūhi garahā ca yā, garahā'va seyyo viññūhi, yaṃ ce bālappasaṃsanā.

76769.meaning1: suffering of solitude; discomfort of seclusion
76769.commentary: (THa) dukkhañ'ca pavivekiyan'ti pavivekato nibbattaṃ kāyakilamathavasena pavattaṃ visamāsanupatāp'ādihetukaṃ kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ, taṃ pana nirāmisavivaṭṭ'ūpanissayatāya viññūnaṃ pāsaṃsā. tena vuttaṃ pavivekadukkhaṃ seyyo'ti.

examples.text: sukhañ'ca kāmamayikaṃ, dukkhañ'ca pavivekiyaṃ, pavivekadukkhaṃ seyyo, yaṃ ce kāmamayaṃ sukhaṃ.

76770.meaning1: derived from sense desire; coming from sensual pleasure

examples.text: sukhañ'ca kāmamayikaṃ, dukkhañ'ca pavivekiyaṃ, pavivekadukkhaṃ seyyo, yaṃ ce kāmamayaṃ sukhaṃ.

76771.meaning1: abandoned sense desire and anger; (or) dispelled the agitation of sense desire

examples.text: kāmakopappahīnā ye, santacittā bhav'ābhave, caranti loke asitā, n'atthi tesaṃ piyāpiyaṃ.

76772.grammar: pr, caus of upasammati, pass, trans (+acc)
76772.commentary: (THa) rajam'uhatañ'ca vātenā'ti ca-iti nipātamattaṃ. yathā gimhānaṃ pacchime māse vātena ūhataṃ uṭṭhitaṃ rajaṃ mahāmegho vassanto upasammaye, vūpasameyya.

examples.text: rajam'uhatañ'ca vātena, yathā megho-upasammaye, evaṃ sammanti saṅkappā, yadā paññāya passati.

76773.meaning1: floods and the snare; deluges and the trap
76773.commentary: (THa) oghapāso'ti kām'ogho, bhav'ogho, diṭṭh'ogho, avijj'ogho'ti (dha. sa. 1156, vibha. 938) evaṃ vuttā cattāro oghā, antalikkhacaro pāso, yv'āyaṃ carati mānaso'ti (mahāva. 33, saṃ. ni. 1.151) evaṃ vutto rāgapāso ca.

examples.text: oghapāso daḷhakhilo, pabbato duppadālayo, chetvā khilañ'ca pāsañ'ca, selaṃ bhetvāna dubbhidaṃ, tiṇṇo pāraṅ'gato jhāyī, mutto so mārabandhanā.

76774.commentary: (THa) daḷhakhilo'ti satthari kaṅkhati, dhamme kaṅkhati, saṅghe kaṅkhati, sikkhāya kaṅkhati, sabrahmacārīsu kupito hoti anattamano āhatacitto khilajāto'ti (ma. ni. 1.185, a. ni. 5.205) evaṃ vutto daḷho thiro pañcavidho cetokhilo ca.

examples.text: oghapāso daḷhakhilo, pabbato duppadālayo, chetvā khilañ'ca pāsañ'ca, selaṃ bhetvāna dubbhidaṃ, tiṇṇo pāraṅ'gato jhāyī, mutto so mārabandhanā.

76775.meaning1: continuity of conditions; succession of conditioned states
76775.commentary: (THa) saṅkhārasantatin'ti kilesa-kammavipāka-ppabheda-saṅkhāra-pabandhaṃ. (NIDD2a) suddhaṃ dhammasamuppādaṃ, suddhaṃ saṅkhārasantatin'ti suddhaṃ passantassa jānantassa saṅkhārānaṃ santatiṃ abbocchinnasaṅkhārasantatiṃ.

examples.text: suddhaṃ dhammasamuppādaṃ, suddhaṃ saṅkhārasantatiṃ, passantassa yathābhūtaṃ, na bhayaṃ hoti gāmaṇi.

76776.meaning1: like grass and twigs; similar to straw and sticks
76776.commentary: (THa) tiṇakaṭṭhasamaṃ lokan'ti yathā araññe apariggahe tiṇakaṭṭhe kenaci gayhamāne aparassa mayhaṃ santakaṃ ayaṃ gaṇhatī'ti na hoti, evaṃ so asāmikatāya tiṇakaṭṭhasamaṃ saṅkhāralokaṃ yadā paññāya passati

examples.text: tiṇakaṭṭhasamaṃ lokaṃ, yadā paññāya passati, mamattaṃ so asaṃvindaṃ, n'atthi me'ti na socati.

76777.meaning1: healer of the whole world; doctor for the entire world
76777.commentary: (THa) tato eva sabbalokassa kilesarogatikicchanato sabbalokatikicchako, sammāsambuddho ācariyo mamā'ti yojanā.

examples.text: sabbaññū sabbadassāvī, jino ācariyo mama, mahākāruṇiko satthā, sabbalokatikicchako.
te pabbajitvā sugatassa sāsane, bhāvetva bojjh'aṅgabalāni paṇḍitā, udaggacittā sumanā kat'indriyā, phusiṃsu nibbānapadaṃ asaṅkhatan'ti.

76779.meaning1: elements of awakening and mental powers; factors of enlightenment and powers

examples.text: te pabbajitvā sugatassa sāsane, bhāvetva bojjh'aṅgabalāni paṇḍitā, udaggacittā sumanā kat'indriyā, phusiṃsu nibbānapadaṃ asaṅkhatan'ti.

76780.commentary: (THa) kañci sattaṃ na ca viheṭhaye, na bādheyyā'ti attho. attano kiccaṃ nāma samaṇadhammo, saṅkhepato sīlasamādhipaññā, taṃ sampādentassa paraviheṭhanāya leso'pi n'atthi tāya sati samaṇabhāvass'eva abhāvato. (THa) attano kiccakārīssā'ti iminā attahitapaṭipattiṃ dasseti, na ca kañci viheṭhaye'ti iminā parahitapaṭipattiṃ, ubhayenā'pi vā attahitapaṭipattim'eva dasseti parāviheṭhanassā'pi attahitapaṭipattibhāvato. atha vā padadvayena'pi attahitapaṭipattiṃ dasseti puthujjanassa sekkhassa ca parahitapaṭipattiyāpi attahitapaṭipattibhāvato.

examples.text: kim'ānupubbaṃ puriso, kiṃ vataṃ kiṃ samācāraṃ, attano kiccakārī'ssa, na ca kañci viheṭhaye.

76781.synonym: anurakkhamāna, ārakkhanta, gopayanta, pālayanta, rakkhanta, rakkhamāna
76781.commentary: (THa) indriyān'eva sārakkhan'ti yasmā indriyasaṃvaro paripuṇṇo sīlasampadaṃ paripūreti, sīlasampadā paripuṇṇā samādhisampadaṃ paripūreti, samādhisampadā paripuṇṇā paññāsampadaṃ paripūreti, tasmā indriy'ārakkhā attahitapaṭipattiyā'va mūlan'ti dassento āha indriyān'eva sārakkhan'ti. satipubbaṅ'gamena ārakkhena saṃrakkhanto yonisomanasikārena indriyāni eva tāva samma'd'eva rakkhanto, yathā akusalacorā tehi tehi dvārehi pavisitvā cittasantāne kusalaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ na vilumpanti, tathā tāni pidahanto'ti attho. sārakkhan'ti ca saṃ-saddassa sābhāvaṃ katvā vuttaṃ, sārāgo'ti-ādīsu viya. saṃrakkhan'ti ca pāṭho.

examples.text: indriyān'eva sārakkhaṃ, indriyāni ca gopayaṃ, attano kiccakārī'ssa, na ca kañci viheṭhaye.

76782.grammar: prp of na nivārayati, neg, caus, trans (+acc)
76782.meaning1: not restraining; not holding back; not holding in check
76782.commentary: (THa) cakkhu'ndriyaṃ ce rūpesu, gacchantaṃ anivārayaṃ. anādīnavadassāvī'ti yo nīlapīt'ādi-bhedesu iṭṭh'āniṭṭhesu rūpāyatanesu gacchantaṃ yathāruci pavattantaṃ cakkhu'ndriyaṃ anivārayaṃ, anivārayanto appaṭibāhanto tathāpavattiyaṃ ādīnavadassāvī na hoti ce, diṭṭhadhammikaṃ samparāyikañ'ca ādīnavaṃ dosaṃ na passati ce. gacchantaṃ nivāraye anissaraṇadassāvī'ti ca pāṭho. tattha yo diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattaṃ bhavissatī'ti (saṃ. ni. 4.95) vuttavidhinā diṭṭhamatte'y'eva ṭhatvā satisampajaññavasena rūp'āyatane pavattamāno tattha nissaraṇadassāvī nāma. vuttavipariyāyena anissaraṇadassāvī daṭṭhabbo.

examples.text: cakkhu'ndriyaṃ ce rūpesu, gacchantaṃ anivārayaṃ, anādīnavadassāvī, so dukkhā na hi muccati.

76783.meaning1: not seeing the escape; not aware of the exit

examples.text: anissaraṇadassāvī, gandhe ce paṭisevati, na so muccati dukkhamhā, gandhesu adhimucchito.

76784.commentary: (THa) tass'attho, sarīraṃ nām'etaṃ pubbena lohitena ca sampuṇṇaṃ bharitaṃ aññena ca pittasemh'ādinā bahunā kuṇapena

examples.text: pubbalohitasampuṇṇaṃ, bahussa kuṇapassa ca, naravīrakataṃ vagguṃ, samuggam'iva cittitaṃ.

76786.commentary: (THa) ta'y'idaṃ naravīrena naresu chekena sipp'ācariyena kataṃ vaggu maṭṭhaṃ lākhāparikamm'ādinā cittitaṃ

examples.text: pubbalohitasampuṇṇaṃ, bahussa kuṇapassa ca, naravīrakataṃ vagguṃ, samuggam'iva cittitaṃ.

76787.commentary: (THa) ta'y'idaṃ naravīrena naresu chekena sipp'ācariyena kataṃ vaggu maṭṭhaṃ lākhāparikamm'ādinā cittitaṃ

examples.text: pubbalohitasampuṇṇaṃ, bahussa kuṇapassa ca, naravīrakataṃ vagguṃ, samuggam'iva cittitaṃ.
kaṭukaṃ madhur'assādaṃ, piyanibandhanaṃ dukhaṃ, khuraṃ'va madhunā littaṃ, ullihaṃ n'āvabujjhati.

76789.meaning1: ties to loved ones; bonds of love

examples.text: kaṭukaṃ madhur'assādaṃ, piyanibandhanaṃ dukhaṃ, khuraṃ'va madhunā littaṃ, ullihaṃ n'āvabujjhati.
kaṭukaṃ madhur'assādaṃ, piyanibandhanaṃ dukhaṃ, khuraṃ'va madhunā littaṃ, ullihaṃ n'āvabujjhati.

76791.meaning1: woman's voice; sound of a woman
76791.commentary: (THa) itthisare'ti itthiyā gītalapitahasitaruditasadde. api ca itthiyā nivatthavatthassa'pi alaṅ'kataalaṅ'kārassa'pi itthipayoganipphāditā veṇuvīṇāsaṅkhapaṇav'ādīnam'pi saddā idha itthisaraggahaṇena gahitā'ti veditabbā. sabbo'p'eso purisassa cittaṃ ākaḍḍhatī'ti.

examples.text: itthirūpe itthisare, phoṭṭhabbe'pi ca itthiyā, itthigandhesu sāratto, vividhaṃ vindate dukhaṃ.

76792.meaning1: woman's sensual charms; woman's allure; sight, sound, smell, taste and touch of woman
76792.commentary: (THa) itthisotāni sabbānī'ti itthiyā rūp'ādiārammaṇāni sabbāni anavasesāni pañca taṇhāsotāni sandanti.

examples.text: itthisotāni sabbāni, sandanti pañca pañcasu, tesam'āvaraṇaṃ kātuṃ, yo sakkoti vīriyavā.

76793.meaning1: concerned with the teaching and the goal
76793.commentary: (THa) kareyya ramamāno'pi, kiccaṃ dhamm'atthasaṃhitan'ti geharatiyā ramamāno'pi dhamm'atthasaṃhitaṃ dhammato atthato ca anapetam'eva taṃ taṃ kattabbaṃ.

examples.text: so atthavā so dhammaṭṭho, so dakkho so vicakkhaṇo, kareyya ramamāno'pi, kiccaṃ dhamm'atthasaṃhitaṃ.

76795.commentary: (THa) tacchanto āṇiyā āṇiṃ, nihanti balavā yathā'ti āha. yathā balavā kāyabalena, ñāṇabalena ca samannāgato tacchako rukkhadaṇḍagataṃ āṇiṃ nīharitu'kāmo tato balavatiṃ āṇiṃ koṭento tato nīharati, tathā kusalo bhikkhu cakkh'ādīni indriyāni vipassanābalena nihantu'kāmo indriyehi eva nihanti.

examples.text: tacchanto āṇiyā āṇiṃ, nihanti balavā yathā, indriyān'indriyeh'eva, nihanti kusalo tathā.

76797.meaning1: mindfulness and wisdom; awareness and understanding
76797.commentary: (SNa) satipaññā ca me buddhā'ti mayā sati ca paññā ca ñātā.

examples.text: saddhaṃ vīriyaṃ samādhiñ'ca, satipaññañ'ca bhāvayaṃ, pañca pañcahi hantvāna, anīgho yāti brāhmaṇo.

76798.commentary: (THa) buddhassa bhagavato vākyabhūtaṃ anusāsaniṃ katvā yath'ānusiṭṭhaṃ paṭipajjitvā ṭhito.

examples.text: so atthavā so dhammaṭṭho, katvā vāky'ānusāsaniṃ, sabbena sabbaṃ buddhassa, so naro sukham'edhatī'ti.

76799.meaning1: knowing the highest goal; understanding the ultimate state

examples.text: ko so pāraṅ'gato loke, ko patto amat'ogadhaṃ, kassa dhammaṃ paṭicchāmi, param'atthavijānanaṃ.
